scope: Phase 1 diagnostic on the four frozen MNQ sleeves; no signal, sizing, stop, exit, or Topstep change.

causality.policy: Every state used for trading day t is the last completed common VIX/MES observation from trading day t-1.
causality.vix_close: daily PX_LAST, shifted one common trading row
causality.mes_close: last observed close inside the completed 09:30-16:00 RTH session; official shortened sessions remain valid completed days
causality.rv10: standard deviation of the last 10 same-contract MES close-to-close log returns, annualized by sqrt(252) and expressed in percent; shifted to t-1
causality.atr14: Wilder RMA(14) of same-contract MES daily true range divided by prior close, expressed in percent; shifted to t-1
causality.roll_policy: MES return and true range are missing on a continuous-contract transition; no roll gap is treated as volatility.

external_states.term_ratio: lagged VIX divided by lagged VIX3M
external_states.evrp: lagged VIX minus lagged MES RV10

partitions.vix_level: low/middle/high from expanding 33.33% and 66.67% quantiles computed through t-1 with 252-day minimum; never full-sample optimized
partitions.term_spread: contango if VIX <= VIX3M, backwardation if VIX > VIX3M
partitions.term_ratio: ratio <= 1 versus ratio > 1; economically identical partition reported for completeness

inference.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 5% across all full-sample controlled external coefficients and both outcomes
inference.first_second_half: split at median eligible session date
inference.year_stability: same coefficient sign as full sample in a strict majority of eligible calendar years

gate_1.study_passes_if: at least one sleeve/external-state/outcome combination passes every criterion

phase_2.selection_reason: The canonical backwardation split passed the controlled left-tail gate; term_ratio is the same economic split, VIX terciles require a non-economic evolving cutoff, and eVRP failed its partition bootstrap gate.
phase_2.rule: Suppress all new entries in all four frozen MNQ sleeves on day t when VIX(t-1) > VIX3M(t-1); otherwise execute the frozen signals unchanged.
